create_MCTSBot: create an async_mcts MCTSBot for a pyspiel game with UCT exploration constant and max simulations
create_RandomRolloutEvaluator: create a RandomRolloutEvaluator for async_mcts MCTSBot with optional random state
run_mcts_search: run async_mcts MCTSBot mcts_search on a pyspiel game state and return the search root node
evaluate_bots: evaluate two async_mcts MCTSBots playing against each other in a zero-sum game
test_SearchNode_best_child: test SearchNode.best_child selects the optimal child based on solved outcomes and visit counts
